fields.name: revision

fields.name: pending_reason
fields.description: Why level is not in force yet ('' when it is): publishing, dns_pending, dns_failed, line_group_empty, cname_splitting, cname_change_required, cname_not_settled, cloudflare_unavailable, level_unavailable, observation_missing (no traffic observation for the window: not every node of the site is ingested past it, the level is held), apply_failed.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: The state revision read (0 when the site was never stepped).

fields.name: dns_ttl
fields.description: TTL the site CNAME's latest retarget carries at the DNS provider; absent when the CNAME was never retargeted.

fields.name: ttl_clamped
fields.description: The provider's TTL floor raised the requested TTL (name.com writes the level D blackhole's 60 seconds as 300).

fields.name: dropped_packets_5m
fields.description: Packets the nodes dropped for the site (level D, XDP / nftables) in the last 5 minutes of node telemetry; absent below level D.

fields.name: drop_shared
fields.description: A node's drop counters are not per site: some of dropped_packets_5m were counted for several level D sites of one node together.

fields.name: platform_dns_hosted
fields.description: Every active domain of the site lies in a zone of a verified DNS provider of the site's tenant. A split site that is hosted (and has no wildcard or zone apex domain) has its domains' default-line records pointed at split_cname by the control plane (cname_auto); otherwise it stays cname_change_required until POST cname-changed.

fields.name: split_cname
fields.description: The site's own CNAME hostname once the split for attack escalation (A->B, package mode CNAME) has settled: the target the site's domains must point at. Absent before that.

fields.name: cname_auto
fields.description: Latest automatic change of the domains' records after the split; absent before any. changed: every domain points at split_cname (counts as confirmed). failed: code says why (dns_record_conflict, dns_record_unconfirmed, dns_provider_*), retried automatically every 10 minutes, the owner may change the record and POST cname-changed. manual: not changed automatically (wildcard_domain, apex_domain, zone_not_hosted, auto_change_unavailable), the owner is told.
